questions.subject: Maths
questions.prompt: A triangle has a base of 10 cm and a height of 5 cm. What is its area?

block.label: Quick Recall
block.sub: Four options, one answer — keep it fast

questions.why: Area equals half of base times height, so ½ × 10 × 5 = 25 cm² — don't forget to halve.

questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: In a sealed container, 25g of reactants react completely. What is the mass of the products?
questions.why: Mass is conserved in a closed system, so the products weigh the same as the reactants: 25g.

questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: What is it called when a chemical reaction gives off light?

questions.prompt: Why do supermarkets often place sugary snacks near the checkout?

questions.subject: PDHPE
questions.prompt: On a chip packet's nutrition label, which nutrient gives the most energy per gram?
questions.why: Fat provides about 9 calories per gram, nearly double carbohydrate's 4 — so even though chips often contain more carbohydrate by mass, fat still delivers the most energy per gram.
